d: Takshashila naresh aambi apne mantrigan ke sath baith jansamany ke bich upje aakrosh ke karnon ko khojne men jute hain, tatha unhen kis tarah shant kiya jae is par vichar kar rahe hain. tabhi aambi apne anuj ko aagya deta hai hai ki kshatrap philipas ko aane ki suchna di jae aur agar usne yavnon ka virodh kiya to uski bhi hatya kar dega. phir kya hota hai aage - dekhie is bhag men
